Assembly only reads a complete 32-byte return word after its exact length is checked; only bool true is accepted. The owner-only nonReentrant rescue forbids both USDC and the manager itself, preserving reserves and the self-call NFT boundary.

The read is gas-capped, copies at most one complete return word, and rejects short/failed returndata. Address consumers now reject nonzero upper address bits; bool consumers require 0 or 1. Wrapper-owner, token-approval and resolver ownership routes are separately tested against malformed address responses.

The self-call reads only the allocated ABI payload, copies no return data and writes no memory; the memory-safe annotation is valid. The call has a fixed 150000-gas budget. executeUSDCTransfer requires the manager as caller and an entered reentrancy guard, and a false/malformed token result reverts token effects inside the isolated call. Failure leaves the original-beneficiary entitlement reserved.

Assembly sends an exact 68-byte selector/hook/job payload with ENS_HOOK_GAS_LIMIT and zero value, requesting no returndata. The optional hook is best effort and its success flag is recorded; it cannot consume unbounded copied returndata or reenter guarded money-moving paths.

newOrRelocatedFindings.rationale: The default duration limit is exactly 10000000 seconds (less than 365 days), retained for economic/deployment compatibility. Numeric digit count does not alter its meaning; the setter bounds future values and timing tests cover the maximum supported duration.

newOrRelocatedFindings.location: Event JobSettlement.ReputationUpdated(address,uint256) (contracts/utils/JobSettlement.sol#11) has address parameters but no indexed parameters
newOrRelocatedFindings.rationale: The library emits the established manager ReputationUpdated signature from the manager address through delegatecall. Leaving its address unindexed preserves decoding compatibility; it affects off-chain filtering efficiency, not entitlement or authorization.

designReview: No-vote settlement escalates without payment; full review and approval challenge use pause-adjusted deadlines.
Buyer-win reward budget comes from forfeited collateral; full escrow is protected.
Buyer acceptance awards no reputation and cannot slash dissenting reviewers.
Credential/controller uniqueness and party/voter/controller adjudicator exclusions preserve normal ENS membership and explicit owner exceptions.
Neutral timeout returns each contributor own funds without judging work quality.
Failed outgoing transfers reserve original-beneficiary claims; isolated token calls roll back false-after-transfer side effects; claims remain excluded from surplus.
Randomized lifecycle checks exercise restricted recipients, claim retries, pause clocks, owner transfers and reserve isolation.
Collusion across undisclosed common-controlled wallets, arbitrator availability, owner pausing and USDC issuer powers remain explicit trust limits.
